metadata.title: ORCHID assessed phase assemblages (binary systems)
metadata.description:
ORCHID assessed phase assemblages (binary systems): one record per named phase field of the expert-drawn (assessed) binary phase diagrams compiled in H. Okamoto's Desk Handbook (ASM International, 2010): the thermodynamic coordinate (T, x, P) of a point deep inside the field and the phase assemblage present there, with phase-registry ids, coordinate uncertainty from the axis calibration, naming basis, confidence and review state, a cross-check against the calculated SGTE diagrams, and citations (original evaluation first, the handbook as compilation). Evidence class assessed_phase_diagram. Part of the ORCHID data release v2026.10.

What

  • 23,131 points from 2,178 diagrams (centroid 21,618, pole of inaccessibility 1,513); 11,962 two-phase points with a drawing-based tie_line block (low credence).
  • ESPEI ZPF datasets, one per diagram: default (two-phase compositions null with a __HYPERPLANE__ at the point) and a variant with tie-line endpoints; validated with ESPEI.
  • JSONL, CSV, Parquet, exclusions with reasons, SCHEMA.md.

Limitations

  • Version 1, machine-extracted: fields named by deterministic rules, model readers, an adjudicator and partial expert review (basis and review state per record).
  • Boundary and tie-line positions are drawing-based; use them as soft constraints at most.
  • No page images, crops or handbook text are distributed.

How to cite

R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID assessed phase assemblages (binary systems) (version 2026.10; Version 1, machine-extracted), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-assessed-phase-assemblages

Part of: R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID data (version 2026.10; Version 1, machine-extracted), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-orchid-data

Cite each diagram's original evaluation and the Okamoto handbook as the compilation.
